goalZh: 会用 be going to 说假期计划,问别人的安排
canDoZh: 能说说自己假期打算做什么、去哪儿,也能问朋友的假期安排

newItems.noteZh: 美国人说 the holidays,指 12 月底圣诞、新年这一段节日;英式 holiday 也指“度假”,美式度假多说 vacation。
t 不发音:“CHRIS-mas”;首字母大写;for Christmas(过圣诞节)。
stay here(留在这儿)/ stay in Seattle;st 之间不加元音,ay 读 /eɪ/。第 7 单元的 stay home 是“待在家里”。
w 开头双唇先收圆;my brother's wedding(我哥哥的婚礼)。
美国大学说 winter break,暑假是 summer break;break 的 ea 读 /eɪ/。
only a month(只有一个月);o 读 /oʊ/;放在要限定的词前面。
o 读 /ʌ/;结尾 th /θ/ 舌尖轻咬;复数 months 不好读,口语里可以读成 “munts”。
重音在第一个音节 JAN-u-ary;月份首字母大写;in January(在一月)。
ea 读长音 /iː/,一定要拉长,短了会变成别的词;go to the beach(去海边)。
重音在后 in-VITE;Thanks for inviting us!(谢谢你邀请我们!)

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: So, what are your plans for the holidays, you guys?
lines.zh: (学期最后一周,学生中心)那么,你们假期有什么打算?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: I'm going to go home to LA for Christmas.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: I'm going to stay here. I was in Mexico for my brother's wedding.
lines.zh: 我留在这儿。前阵子为了哥哥的婚礼回过墨西哥了。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: And the tickets are really expensive now.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Me too. I'm going to stay here with my family.
lines.zh: 我也留在这儿,和家人一起过。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: What about you, Lei? Are you going to go home to Chengdu?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I wanted to, but winter break is only a month.
lines.zh: 我本来想回,可是寒假只有一个月。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And the tickets are too expensive. So I'm going to stay here, too.
lines.zh: 而且机票太贵了。所以我也留在这儿。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Then come to LA! It's sunny and warm there.
lines.zh: 那就来洛杉矶!那儿又晴又暖和。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Really? How warm is it in winter?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: About 70 degrees! Come in January. We can go to the beach!
lines.zh: 七十度左右!一月来吧,我们可以去海边!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sounds good! Thanks for inviting us, Ethan!
lines.zh: 好啊!谢谢你邀请我们,伊森!

grammar.titleZh: 用 be going to 说假期计划
grammar.bodyZh: 说已经打算好的假期安排,用 be going to + 动词原形(第 7 单元学过):I'm going to stay here. / He's going to go home to LA.。问别人:What are your plans for the holidays? / Are you going to go home?。美国大学的寒假叫 winter break;12 月底的节日(圣诞、新年等)统称 the holidays。问假期多长:How long is winter break? — About a month.。I wanted to(我本来想……)是 I wanted to go home 的省略,后面的动词前面说过就不用重复。发音:break 里的 ea 读 /eɪ/,和 great 一样,不要读成 /iː/。

examples.text: What are your plans for the holidays?
How long is winter break? — About a month.
examples.zh: 寒假放多久?——一个月左右。
